desc: The Elevation 2.0 is a premium, lightweight hunting rifle designed for the recreational hunter. It comes standard with a carbon fiber barrel, a carbon fiber stock, a Zermatt Arms Origin action, and a TriggerTech trigger, all backed by our SUB MOA accuracy guarantee. Available in Black Granite and Tactical Flat Dark Earth, it features our Sendero contour carbon fiber barrel, Hawkins Precision BDL bottom metal (M5 inlet), and carbon fiber stock.
